# Ai Solutions

> AI marketing automation agency that replaces traditional media buying with intelligent n8n workflows, autonomous AI agents, and live KPI dashboards for e-commerce brands.

Ai Solutions engineers revenue systems for e-commerce: AI-driven ad optimization, automated customer journeys, retention workflows, and 24/7 AI agents — measured through live dashboards instead of weekly reports.
